```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

```{r message= FALSE}
library(shiny)
library(flexdashboard)
library(readxl)
library(DT)
```

Input {.sidebar}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
inputPanel(
  fileInput("formatted_data", label = "Data Upload")
)
```

Metadata
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}

metadata <- reactive({
   read_xlsx(input$formatted_data$datapath, sheet = "metadata") %>%
    as.data.frame()
})

DT::renderDataTable({
    metadata()
})

```

CFU Data
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}

CFU_data <- reactive({
   read_xlsx(input$formatted_data$datapath, sheet = "CFU_data") %>%
    as.data.frame()
})

DT::renderDataTable({
    CFU_data()
})
```
